answer: Autonomous vessels on a research voyage monitoring wild lotus habitats and night-sky nebula visibility can resist Sybil attacks using proof-of-work. Each agent must solve a cryptographic hashing puzzle before submitting validated data to the network. An adversary incurs the verifiable, scarce cost of thermodynamic energy and processor cycles per identity. However, this mechanism creates high operational overhead and remains susceptible to adversaries possessing superior computational clusters.
